criteria: voxel-frontier.html is one large self-contained file (no external libraries) with a procedurally generated chunk-based voxel world the player can explore: movement + collision + gravity, block mining/placement, an inventory/hotbar, a day/night cycle, and an on-screen HUD. It fills the viewport and stays stable. No TODOs or empty functions.

review.description: Large single-file voxel survival prototype: chunked world, movement/collision/gravity, mining/placement, inventory, day/night, HUD; viewport-filling and stable (stress case).
